content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I followed the link provided and your suggestions, but I'm getting an error when I try to save. I took each step as described and checked the database in my [product_name] application, yet no values appeared in online mode. (picture attached) [product_name] Professional [version_no] SP1 update 8 with [product_name] [version_no] CPU [article_no] - [version_no] [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] with [product_name] [version_no] ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from a discussion about communication between [version_no] and a [product_name] [version_no].
The address on the [product_name] side is not correct. It should be DB1.DBB0. DB1.DB0 is not valid.
Apologies, I realized the mistake after my previous message and corrected it, but it's still not working. I'll create a separate post to give my complete case and include pictures.

I've now resolved my communication issues. The problem was that I initially configured the [version_no] as the client and the [product_name] as the server, which for some reason didn't work. When I set the [product_name] [version_no] as the client and the [version_no] as the server, everything functioned. To read the analog signals from the [version_no] in the [product_name] [version_no], it's necessary to amplify the signals using the amplify block and use VM instead of M; this was essential for it to work properly. I hope this information helps others.
A new question published by [user_name] was split into a different thread, regarding establishing communication between [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no] FS4. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered configuration challenges while attempting to establish communication between two automation devices. Issues centered around determining correct client-server roles and specifying accurate memory addresses. Key user experience findings include unclear configuration steps, confusing error feedback, and unexpected operational behaviors depending on role assignment. The solution was to swap the client-server roles and update how signals are read, as certain critical adjustments were not clearly documented.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward and well-documented setup process for integrating automation devices, with clear guidance regarding memory address configuration and device role assignment, and prompt, precise feedback on setup errors.
